name: boAt 2026 Launch Airdopes Joy v2, 35H Battery, Pocketable Design, ASAP™ Charge, 13mm Drivers, Easy Touch Controls, ENx™ Tech, IWP™ & App Support TWS Bluetooth Earbuds with mic (Eclipse Black)
description: Up to 35 Hours of Total Playtime: Fuel your weekly entertainment without facing constant battery anxiety. This 35-hour playback window makes it a breeze to tick off your entire watchlist during long daily commutes or weekend road trips. It effectively solves the problem of keeping your soundtrack alive when you are far away from a wall outlet. • Sleek and Pocketable Design: Boasting an ergonomically pocketable design, these ultra-compact earbuds are incredibly easy to pop into your backpack or tight jeans pocket. This is a game-changer for minimalist travelers who hate carrying bulky cases. You can move freely through your day knowing your music is tucked away effortlessly. • 13mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Upgrade your everyday listening experience with large 13mm drivers that deliver matchless boAt Signature Sound. Simply tap to skip tracks, adjust volume, or accept incoming phone calls while multitasking through your hectic routine. It eliminates the constant need to reach into your pocket or bag for your smartphone. • 2 Mics with ENx Technology: Experience uncompromised conversation clarity thanks to dual microphones enhanced with environmental noise cancellation. Answer critical calls without a hitch outdoors as the smart tech wards off chaotic background distortion. Your voice is heard perfectly, whether you are walking through a bustling market or a windy street.
